correctness.rationale: For every finite cograph, induction from isolated vertices through unions and joins gives the missing-empty-pattern lemma and the exact induced-matching-transversal characterization. A constructive maximal-independent-set extension proves sufficiency in arbitrary graphs. Cotree polynomial follows coefficientwise. Standard-library exhaustive verifier checks all 1100 labeled graphs through order five, 536 cographs, and the 132 labeled noncograph obstructions in three isomorphism types; enumeration is not substituted for induction.
